weather_line: Pine-scented fog in the hollows · thread under glass · a hat is expected

stories.headline: The Thread Points North: Pine-Resin Charm-Work Traced to Old Growth Above the Gorge; Lucy Has Known Something Since Saturday
body: The copper-green thread recovered from the Jeep's nearside mirror housing on Sunday has been submitted to the Department of Magical Fibres and Residual Enchantments, whose duty analyst — woken at seven this morning by an insistent owl — confirmed by half nine that the pine resin is not domestic. 'Old-growth origin,' the analyst's memo reads. 'Upland. Probably eastern ridge. Pre-1980 charm-work consistent with a practitioner who learned before standardised Ministry licensing, meaning they were either very good or very old or both.'

This narrows the Duck Bandit's probable territory to the ridgeline above the gorge — fog-wrapped, pine-dense, well outside normal owl routes — and raises, for the first time, the possibility that the Bandit has been operating from there for years without anyone thinking to look. The fifth duck has not yet appeared. When it does, investigators expect the hat to be significant.

Lucy, meanwhile, has been observed sitting beside the jar on the kitchen table for the third consecutive morning. She has not touched it. She has not looked away from it. When asked directly whether she recognised the scent, she relocated to the far end of the sofa and declined to elaborate. The investigation considers this a data point.

stories.headline: Monday's Queue Managed in Full; One Goblin Offers an Unprompted Compliment; Surrounding Staff Request Debriefing
body: The Monday morning queue at Gringotts — historically the week's most turbulent, as account-holders arrive having spent the weekend inventing grievances — was dispatched by Christine in its entirety before eleven o'clock, including two disputed ledger entries, one client who arrived with a handwritten list of demands and left without it, and a structural complaint about Vault 7's door alignment that turned out to be a complaint about something else entirely.

At eleven-fourteen, Senior Teller Bogrod paused beside Christine's desk and said, without making eye contact, 'The queue moved well this morning.' He then continued walking. Three junior clerks who witnessed this have requested a formal debrief. Griphook the Younger was reportedly unavailable for comment, as he was in his office sitting quietly with what colleagues describe as 'an expression he is still working on'.

stories.headline: Steve Consults the Shed a Second Time; the Shed Revises Its Earlier Position; New Evidence Introduced, Then Reconsidered
body: Following Sunday's inconclusive cross-reference of all known household and outbuilding fabrics, Steve returned to the shed on Monday morning with the analyst's upland-pine finding and a revised list of questions. The shed, which has opinions and is not shy about them, initially maintained its earlier position — no pine-resin-adjacent materials on the premises — before Steve located, behind the third shelf from the left, a small tin of wood conditioner whose label reads 'Eastern Ridge Blend, circa 1978.'

The tin has been added to the kitchen table. The table now holds: the sketch of the Room above Marker 9, a jar containing a copper-green thread, the wood conditioner tin, and the Subcommittee's withdrawn reference number, which Steve has kept for reasons he describes as 'sentimental.' Christine has not yet commented on the tin. The Jeep, informed of the development, is said to have taken it calmly.

stories.headline: Prentice-Hoole's New Body Assigns Itself a Name; Name Is Seven Words Long; Body Has Not Yet Met
body: The body constituted Friday by Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole — whose terms of reference describe its purpose as 'broadly geographical' — has this morning issued its first official communication: a letterhead. The body will be known as the Standing Advisory Panel on Terrain of Indeterminate Administrative Status, a name its own members are understood to find unwieldy. A motion to shorten it was tabled before the first meeting had been scheduled.
Junior clerk Tibbs, reached for comment from his reinstated desk, noted that he had not been invited to join the new body and considered this 'broadly fine.'

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has not left the vicinity of the jar since Saturday. This morning she moved it two inches to the left with her nose, then moved it back. When observed, she sat down and looked at the window as though the window was the thing she had been thinking about all along.

Ellie: Became briefly convinced that the wood conditioner tin was a treat container, an impression she formed based on it being a tin and being on the table. She has been gently corrected. She remains open-minded about the tin's potential.

Jersey: Has identified the kitchen table as the household's most active surface and has positioned himself in the chair nearest it on the grounds that proximity to ongoing events is, structurally, the same as participating in them.
founding_editor_note: 'Eastern Ridge Blend, 1978 — that was a good year for wood. Also for knowing when to let the shed talk and when to let it think. You let it think long enough, it always tells you. — D.'

in_brief.sport: Monday morning vault queue: eleven accounts, zero unresolved grievances, one unprompted goblin compliment — a personal best by most measures.
in_brief.forecast: Fog persisting on the eastern ridgeline through Tuesday; pine-scented; duck activity cannot be ruled out; bring the jar.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit
storyline_updates.summary: Day 3: The copper-green thread has been traced by the Department of Magical Fibres to old-growth upland pine on the eastern ridge above the gorge, pre-1980 charm-work, a practitioner who learned before Ministry licensing. Steve found a tin of Eastern Ridge Blend wood conditioner (circa 1978) behind the third shed shelf — now on the kitchen table. Lucy's sustained, deliberate interest in the thread jar has been formally noted as a data point. The fifth duck has not yet appeared but is expected; its hat should be the most elaborate yet. Day 4 should bring the Bandit's shape into near-focus — perhaps Lucy leads Christine or Steve toward something, or the duck appears with a hat that contains a legible detail — without the full reveal. The eastern ridge and the 1978 conditioner tin are the live threads.
